end.summary:
Practised making one mark for each object.
Parth used small circles as marks.
They matched six sheep with six marks and four marks with four fingers.
Unaided correct in 2 of 5 attempts; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised one-to-one tracking with Parth using circles, sheep, wall marks, and fingers. They clearly explained that each object gets one mark in several examples. They mixed up whether to repeat the marking activity and became ready to stop; this was not corrected after the last seen attempt. At home, try matching small groups of objects to the same number of dots, one object at a time.
